title: IMPLEMENT Thermal Ticket Print Page and Binary BYTEA Decoding
content:
**What**: Created dynamic Astro SSR page `src/pages/facturas/[id]/imprimir.astro` with base64 Data URL decoding (`data:image/...;base64,...`) for PostgreSQL `BYTEA` logo and QR binary columns.
**Why**: Replaces legacy EJS print view with a high-performance thermal print layout supporting 80mm and 58mm POS receipt printers.
**Where**: `src/pages/facturas/[id]/imprimir.astro`, `BillingPOS.tsx`.
**Learned**: Using Astro CSS CSS-in-JS `define:vars={{ anchoPapel: ... }}` allows dynamic thermal paper width styling directly driven by database configuration.
